prose: Basis: the Techmeme summary of the report; the Bloomberg article could not be fetched. A court filing shows Disney agreed to hire more than 60 staff from Character.AI, paying them roughly $180M over three years plus $30M in retention awards.
The arrangement - a soft landing for workers at a company in bankruptcy - still requires a bankruptcy judge's approval.
highlights: Disney to hire 60+ Character.AI staff, per filing
~$180M over three years plus $30M retention awards
Framed as a lifeline amid Character.AI's bankruptcy
